primary_source.author: Rajan Gupta
primary_source.title: Introduction to Lattice QCD
exact_comparisons: U_course=(U_source)^-1 matches endpoint laws. The corresponding plaquettes are inverse matrices, so real traces agree.
For isotropic SU3, source dimensionless (6/g^2) Re tr((I-P)/3) equals S_course/hbar at g=gYM.
At the midpoint-exponential level, A_course=i gYM A_source after the specified link inversion; actual finite links in F14 are ODE transport, not an asserted equality to midpoint exponentials.
The fixed-spacing spectral logarithm retains hbar/delta-tau and has a fully proved domain; no source continuum-limit or reconstruction conclusion is imported.
primary_source.source_correction: lqcd.tex line 557 gives [0,1] for matrix entries. The correct statement is modulus at most one. diag(i,-i) in SU2 is a counterexample to the stated real interval; receiving proof L Section 7.
not_used: The cited but unread Luscher transfer proof
A non-Abelian curvature expansion asserted only up to unspecified numeric factors

owner_additions: Three mechanical TeX defects in the independent transfer proof repaired without changing their mathematical content.
The periodic quadrature estimate is strengthened from 5/12 to 1/12, with a complete additional proof and original estimates retained.
scope: Finite compact regulators and quantitative comparison on a fixed smooth classical field; no interacting continuum construction or uniform limiting gap asserted.
